modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from size mixer

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
check for the necessary items like weighing scale& other measuring equipment
meet the previous shift size mixer & discuss with him/ her the
issues faced by them with respect to the quality, reuse of size, wastage etc., or safety or any other specific instruction etc.
check the size level in the storage tank and check whether any size mixing has to be prepared immediately for the running program.
check the size mix given by the higher authority for the running program
check the availability of the sizing ingredients & chemicals required for the running program
take instructions in writing for the size mixing for the next programs from the higher authority.
check availability of the size ingredients & the size chemicals required for the next shift
maintain the stock of the sizing ingredients, sizing chemicals etc. in the register and to show the same to the higher authority.
check the availability of good quality of water for mixing
check the steam quality

modules.module_title: Handing over shift to size mixer

pcs.pc_description: hand over the shift to the incoming size mixer in a proper manner & get clearance from him before leaving the work spot
report to his/ her shift superiors as well as that of the incoming shift, in case his/ her counterpart doesn't report for work
hand over the shift to the incoming shift superior in case his/her counterpart does not arrive& get clearance from him/ her before leaving the work spot

report to his/ her shift superior about the quality / production / safety issues/any other issue faced in his/ her shift and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from His/ Her superiors
ensure the work place is clean & tidy

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the size cooker is cleaned before any new mixing is prepared.
weigh the size ingredients, size chemicals etc. required for preparing the new mixing.
drain out condensed water from the size cooker.
fill water in the cooker as per the size mixing given
check the steam pressure in the line
pour hardened materials like PVA first & stir it so that it gets dissolved in the water completely
pour maize starch and other chemicals as per the size mixing given
ensure that all these materials poured in the cooker are dissolved completely.
close the cooker lid and open steam
allow the chemicals to cook for 20 minutes at a temp of 130 degree Celsius
check the viscosity & refractrometer reading for the size
check whether the storage tank is completely cleaned. if not, to clean the same.
drain out the left over size of the previous shift to collect in other storage vessels as per the instructions of the higher authority.
transfer the size prepared to the Storage Tank
wear the protecting tools like shoes, gloves etc., whenever required.
keep all the vessels and the working area neat & clean
give preference to safety. should not enter the area, where he/ she are not allowed. should not do a job in which training has not being given
ensure that no size / sizing material / any other material in the other work areas.
report immediately to the Superior for any problem
